title: Technician privileges map
idea: Technicians get one slice of HF phone (10 meters) and the run of VHF and UHF. A few edges and spots are worth memorizing.

rows: HF: 200 W PEP. Above 30 MHz: 1500 W PEP

config.heading: Your bands
config.lead: Pick a band, then tap a segment or a frequency.

bands.name: 10 m
bands.text: Technicians' only HF phone band. HF power limit for Technicians: 200 watts PEP.

segs.label: Propagation beacons
segs.text: Automatically controlled HF propagation beacons are found on 10 meters, 28.200 to 28.300 MHz.

segs.label: Technician phone (SSB)
segs.text: Technicians may use phone from 28.300 to 28.500 MHz. 10 meters is the only HF band where Technicians have phone privileges.

bands.name: 6 m
bands.text: Above 30 MHz, Technicians may run up to 1500 watts PEP, except for some specific restrictions. SSB is allowed in at least some segment of every band above 50 MHz.

segs.label: CW only
segs.text: 50.0 to 50.1 MHz is limited to CW only.

marks.label: 52.525 MHz
marks.text: A frequency in the 6 meter band, which runs 50 to 54 MHz.

bands.name: 2 m
bands.text: Common repeater offset: plus or minus 600 kHz. Up to 1500 watts PEP above 30 MHz.

segs.label: CW only
segs.text: 144.0 to 144.1 MHz is limited to CW only.

marks.label: National FM simplex calling frequency
marks.text: 146.520 MHz is the national calling frequency for FM simplex on 2 meters.

bands.name: 70 cm
bands.text: Common repeater offset: plus or minus 5 MHz. Up to 1500 watts PEP above 30 MHz.

traps.why: Technician phone on 10 m starts at 28.300 and runs to 28.500 MHz.
Technicians have HF phone on 10 meters only.

traps.wrong: 219 MHz to 220 MHz and 420.0 MHz to 420.1 MHz
traps.why: The CW-only segments are the bottom 100 kHz of 6 and 2 meters: 50.0-50.1 and 144.0-144.1 MHz.
Technician HF power limit is 200 watts PEP.
Above 30 MHz, Technicians can run the full 1500 watts PEP.
5 MHz is the 70 cm offset. 2 meters uses 600 kHz.
600 kHz is the 2 m offset. 70 cm uses 5 MHz.
6 meters runs 50 to 54 MHz, so 49 MHz is just below it.

traps.wrong: Anywhere in the Technician portion of 10 meters
traps.why: HF beacons have their own slice: 28.200 to 28.300 MHz.
